statement: Symplectic ball packing in higher dimensions. Resolves the Siegel–Yao conjecture for arbitrary capacities in every dimension $`2n\ge6`$. Finitely many closed symplectic balls of capacities $`R_1,\ldots,R_k`$ embed disjointly into an open ball of capacity R exactly when $`\sum_iR_i^n\lt R^n`$ and $`R_i+R_j\lt R`$ for every distinct pair i, j.
